Ireland Secures Historic T20 Series Win Over India

Ireland has achieved its first-ever bilateral series victory against India in any format, winning the T20 series 2-0. The second T20 match saw Ireland defeat the reigning T20 world champions by one run in Belfast. This marks a significant achievement for Irish cricket, with discussions also surrounding player selection for the Indian team, particularly the debut of young Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.
